description: This Java class defines a substitution strategy for modifying the Subject ID within a ModifySubject command, replacing placeholders with substituted values based on a given algorithm.

classes.name: ModifySubjectSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy, responsible for substituting Subject IDs in ModifySubject commands using a provided algorithm.

methods.name: ModifySubjectSubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy for ModifySubject objects.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs substitution on the Subject ID within a ModifySubject object using the provided substitution algorithm, returning a modified copy if changes occur.
